### This 'main' release is an automatically generated snapshot of the `main` branch. It is updated on every push and may be broken or incomplete. The version string ends in `-main.<date>+<commit>`; the mod list shows it as **RIMAPI Debug Actions [Main]**.

### Install

1. Install **RIMAPI** ([Steam Workshop](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3593423732)
   or [GitHub](https://github.com/IlyaChichkov/RIMAPI/releases)) and its dependency **Harmony**.
2. Quit RimWorld, download `RimApiDebugActions-<version>.zip` from **Assets** below and extract it into your
   RimWorld `Mods` folder, so that the path is `Mods/RimApiDebugActions/About/About.xml`.
3. In the mod list, load **RIMAPI Debug Actions** after **RIMAPI**.

#### Supported RimWorld version: 1.7 (built against RIMAPI 1.10.0)

This mod runs any listed debug action on request. Use it only in a trusted local development setup.
